papers.title_en: Characterising and Analysing Retrieval-Augmented Generation Techniques
papers.authors: Emmanuel Igbekele, Olawande Daramola
papers.evidence: 用于刻画与分析RAG技术的概念框架
papers.tldr: 大语言模型在多领域应用扩大，RAG被用于减少幻觉并提升表现，但现有RAG技术繁多，针对具体问题难以选择。论文提出含主维度与子维度的概念框架，用于刻画“是什么”并分析“表现如何”。该框架基于文献中RAG属性进行定性分析构建，可作为实证基准前的筛选机制。帮助研究者和实践者以较低计算与资金成本选出更匹配用户与任务需求的RAG候选。
papers.abstract_en: The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) across many application domains has increased the need for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to reduce hallucinations and improve LLM performance. Thus far, several RAG techniques with impressive features and capabilities have been proposed in the literature, making it a herculean task to select the most appropriate RAG techniques for specific problem scenarios. Thus, we propose a conceptual framework comprising main dimensions and sub-dimensions for characterising (defining "what it is") and analysing (defining "how well it does") existing RAG techniques. The conceptual framework was developed through a qualitative analysis of the attributes of RAG techniques reported in the literature. It can serve as a pre-empirical filtering mechanism for researchers and practitioners in selecting the highest-fit RAG candidates that meet specific user and task requirements before empirical benchmarking of RAG techniques, which can be computationally and financially expensive.

papers.title_en: Darwin-Claw: Environment-Adaptive Experience Consolidation for Recursively Self-Evolving Agents
papers.authors: Mingze Yin, Xiaohan Wang, Dian Li, Longfei Luo, Jiahong Yan, Yiheng Zhu, Chang-Yu Hsieh
papers.evidence: 面向自演化智能体的环境自适应经验巩固与记忆更新
papers.tldr: 当前LLM智能体多在孤立会话中运行，难以从历史交互中持续学习或适应用户特定环境，而现有自我进化范式往往不加筛选地注入原始轨迹，导致行为模式模糊、更新可控性差。为此作者提出环境自适应自进化框架Darwin-Claw，通过分层经验固化系统将情景经验蒸馏为细粒度错误归因并泛化为动态更新的原型向量，作为交互补丁与显式优化信号，驱动技能与记忆协同进化。在WildClawBench上取得显著性能提升，为自主智能体的持续用户化适应提供可控稳定路径。
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across complex tasks, they predominantly operate in isolated sessions, lacking the ability to continually learn from historical interactions or adapt to user-specific environments. Existing self-evolution paradigms often indiscriminately inject raw interaction trajectories into memory or skill modules, leading to obscured behavioral patterns and compromised update controllability. Furthermore, as foundational LLM reasoning improves, the bottleneck for agentic evolution shifts from accumulating generic knowledge to effectively managing situational experience. To address this, we propose Darwin-Claw, an environment-adaptive self-evolving framework that systematically distills episodic experiences to drive the comprehensive evolution of operational skills and durable memory. Theoretically grounded in an iterative agent-actor and evolver-critic co-adaptation, Darwin-Claw introduces a Hierarchical Experience Consolidation System that extracts fine-grained error attributions and generalizes them into dynamically updated prototype vectors. This structured situational experience serves as interaction patches for context-sensitive perception and explicit optimization signals for skill refinement. Practically, Darwin-Claw is a readily deployable, automated framework compatible with mainstream agent systems without requiring manual curation. Extensive experiments on WildClawBench demonstrate that Darwin-Claw yields substantial performance improvements, establishing a controllable and stable pathway for the continual, user-centric adaptation of autonomous agents in real-world ecosystems.

papers.title_en: HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory
papers.authors: Junming Zhang, Rubin Wei, Xu Cheng, Hao Sun, Jiarui Wang, Ruoxi Cheng, Xiquan Wang, Peisong Wu, Mingsong Chen, Zhouhan Lin
papers.evidence: 评估智能体记忆系统跨长期交互归纳习惯的基准
papers.tldr: 长期交互中，用户习惯只能从零散选择里间接体现，单次观测往往只提供部分证据。作者提出 HABIT-Bench，用任务型对话与受控习惯图合成跨餐饮、金融、软件、旅游四个领域、数百轮会话的用户历史，并以四选一任务检验智能体能否推断习惯并恰当应用，任务涵盖临时例外、习惯变化与用户未接受的建议。八个记忆方法在 Qwen3-235B-A22B 与 GLM-5.3-Flash 上评测，最佳宏平均准确率仅 33.61%。
papers.abstract_en: In long-term interactions with large language model (LLM) agents, users reveal habits through their choices and actions. These habits capture implicit user information that agents must infer across conversations. However, individual observations may provide only partial evidence about a habit or when it applies. Retaining past interactions alone does not ensure that agents can infer habits and apply them appropriately. We introduce HABIT-Bench to evaluate how well agent memory systems infer habits from weak evidence and apply them to later requests. We construct synthetic user histories from task-oriented dialogue data and controlled habit graphs. The histories span hundreds of sessions across food, finance, software, and travel. Four-choice tasks assess agents' ability to infer user habits and apply them appropriately. They include temporary exceptions, changes in habits, and suggestions that users have not accepted. Sampled tasks undergo independent human review. We evaluate eight memory methods with Qwen3-235B-A22B and GLM-5.3-Flash. The best-performing memory method achieves 33.61\% macro accuracy across the four domains. Performance remains limited even when annotated evidence is supplied directly. These results expose a persistent gap between access to past interactions and the ability to infer and appropriately use user habits.

papers.title_en: DialogMem: Evaluating Dialogue-Grounded Embodied Memory in 3D Environments
papers.authors: SeongJun Jeong, Junghyun Kim, Gi-Cheon Kang, Byoung-Tak Zhang
papers.evidence: 评估对话接地的具身智能体记忆形成与检索的基准
papers.tldr: 现有具身记忆多依赖视觉经验，难以将人类对话与3D环境中的具体物体关联。DialogMem构建两阶段基准，让智能体从时间对齐的RGB-D观测和对话中形成记忆，并用于实例级物体导航与问答。实验发现，评估时加入对话能显著提升问答，却几乎不改善导航，说明对话未被物体级接地。该基准揭示形成时的对话接地、正确条目检索与空间定位三大瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents in human-centered environments require memory that integrates what they observe with what humans tell them over time. However, existing embodied memories are built primarily from visual experience, leaving open how dialogue with humans can be grounded in the objects encountered throughout that experience. We introduce DialogMem, a two-phase benchmark in which agents build memory from time-aligned streams of posed RGB-D observations and dialogue, and later use it for instance-level object navigation and question answering (QA). DialogMem provides 142 episodes across 27 real-world 3D scenes, with 14,193 QA pairs and 11,890 navigation instructions. We evaluate nine memory representations within a unified framework of memory formation, evidence retrieval, and reasoning for task outputs. In experiments, appending dialogue to visual memory at evaluation time substantially improves QA but yields negligible navigation gains, suggesting that relevant dialogue is present in memory but not grounded to specific objects. Controlled diagnostics show that navigation improves with link quality but falls short of ground-truth object-level memory even under perfect linking. Retrieving the correct object entry and recovering its spatial location remain further bottlenecks. These results identify three bottlenecks for dialogue-grounded embodied memory: grounding and organizing dialogue at object-level entries during formation, retrieving the correct entry, and localizing it accurately.

papers.title_en: Learning What to Remember: Resource-Efficient Self-Improvement for Lifelong Agents
papers.authors: Guannan Lai, Zi-Yang Bai, Jun-Peng Jiang, Han-Jia Ye
papers.evidence: 面向自我改进智能体的终身记忆，决定哪些经验值得复用
papers.tldr: 终身智能体在生成、交互与记忆资源联合受限时，盲目积累经验未必提升决策，现有终身记忆方法甚至不如简单检索或无记忆。TokenWorth从稀疏执行反馈中学习查询相关的记忆价值，在不更新主干模型的前提下指导经验检索与有界记忆管理。在三个LifelongAgentBench环境及本地/API部署中，它以更少输出token取得最高任务成功率。这表明资源受限自改进的关键不是记住更多，而是学会判断什么值得记住。
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving agents aim to continuously improve their behavior by learning from experience after deployment. However, accumulating and reusing more experience does not necessarily lead to better decisions, particularly when generation, interaction, and memory resources are jointly constrained. Under such stringent constraints, we find that several existing lifelong-memory methods provide limited benefits over simple retrieval or even no-memory agents. This reveals a fundamental challenge for resource-efficient self-improvement: agents must learn not only which past experiences are relevant, but which are actually worth reusing to improve future decisions. When memory capacity and opportunities for reasoning and recovery are limited, retrieving an ineffective experience can consume scarce resources and hinder downstream execution. To address this challenge, we propose TokenWorth, a lightweight feedback-driven memory adaptation framework that learns query-dependent memory worth from sparse execution feedback. Without updating the backbone model, TokenWorth uses the learned worth to guide both experience retrieval and bounded memory management, enabling the agent to continually adapt how it reuses accumulated experience. Across three LifelongAgentBench environments and both local and API-based deployments, TokenWorth achieves the highest task success rate while using the fewest output tokens among the evaluated methods under the specified resource budgets. These results suggest that effective self-improvement under resource constraints depends not on accumulating more experience, but on learning what is worth remembering. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/AIGNLAI/TokenWorth.

papers.title_en: DuplexLedger: Benchmarking Transactional Memory in Full-Duplex Speech Agents
papers.authors: Yuxuan Li, Xiangchen Guan, Kunrong Li, Jin Wang, Kaiwen Luo, Yang Xiao, Yufei Guo, Zhisheng Chen, Liang Lin, Kun Wang
papers.evidence: 面向语音智能体持久记忆写入、更新与忽略决策的基准
papers.tldr: 全双工语音代理需在听说同时维护持久记忆，但现有基准割裂交互时序与记忆结果，难以判断事件该写入、修订还是忽略。作者提出DuplexLedger双语基准，含1094个会话、事件级写/更新/忽略/保留监督及6564个同会话问题，并给出ACT-Mem侧车模块。评估显示交互-记忆鸿沟显著，最佳最终状态事实覆盖率仅2.01%；ACT-Mem将最新值准确率由4.11%升至8.68%，减少过时断言与干扰采纳。该工作推动可审计的选择性全双工记忆。
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex speech agents must update persistent memory while listening and speaking, yet it remains unclear which events should be stored, revised, or excluded. Existing benchmarks isolate interaction timing from memory outcomes, obscuring the state transitions behind a correct answer. We introduce DuplexLedger, a bilingual benchmark of 1,094 persistent sessions aligning four full-duplex scenarios with event-level Write/Update/Ignore/Retain supervision, explicit pre/post memory states, and 6,564 same-session questions and checks. Evaluating five full-duplex models reveals an interaction-memory gap: no system combines strong boundary control with coherent final-state memory, and the best final-state fact coverage is 2.01%. We propose ACT-Mem, an 8.92M-parameter sidecar comprising an event controller, a versioned transactional ledger, and a typed retriever coupled with a frozen MiniCPM-o 4.5 backbone. On 219 held-out sessions, ACT-Mem increases latest-value accuracy from 4.11% to 8.68% while reducing stale assertions and distractor adoption. It improves interaction boundaries but slows interruption stopping. These results motivate selective, auditable full-duplex memory rather than indiscriminate transcript retention. Code is available at https://github.com/lyx-researcher/DuplexLedger.

papers.title_en: RAG-NIMBF: A Non-Invasive, Modular Benchmarking Framework for Automated RAG Configuration Analysis
papers.authors: Niclas Hart, Nicolas Weeger
papers.evidence: 面向RAG配置分析的非侵入式模块化基准框架
papers.tldr: RAG 的配置空间涵盖切块、嵌入、检索、重排、提示与生成模型，各组件如何交互缺乏指导。作者提出 RAG-NIMBF，以非侵入方式挂载在现有 RAG 流程上，通过受控消融与端到端实验追踪评估配置组合。在 SQuAD 上跨多个生成模型验证显示：MMR 使 nDCG@5 提升 4 至 11 个百分点，更详细的提示指令对强推理模型提升 10 至 13 个百分点。该框架把配置调优变为可复现、可比较的实验，支撑基于证据的决策。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become the dominant paradigm for grounding the outputs of large language models (LLM) in external knowledge. However, practitioners are faced with a vast configuration space comprising chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, prompting and generation models, and there is limited guidance on how these components interact. We present RAG-NIMBF, a modular benchmarking framework that attaches to existing RAG pipelines as a non-invasive evaluation layer. It evaluates the configuration space through controlled ablation with end-to-end experiment tracking. The evaluation combines LLM-based answer quality scores, retrieval correctness measures, and runtime indicators. This study validates the framework across multiple generation models on the SQuAD dataset. This process reveals non-obvious interactions and demonstrates how the experiments are tracked. The findings indicate that the retrieval balance of relevance and diversity substantially enhances the relevance and coverage of retrieved context in comparison to a conventional similarity search, with MMR raising nDCG@5 by +4 to +11 percentage points across the swept models. More detailed prompt instructions meaningfully increase how faithfully generated answers stick to the retrieved evidence, especially for capable and reasoning models (+10 to +13pp on Qwen3.6-27B, GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3.5-think, but negligible on the 20B generator). Overall, RAG-NIMBF transforms the configuration space of RAG into reproducible, comparable experiments. By attaching to existing production pipelines in a non-invasive way, it enables practitioners to systematically evaluate and improve deployed systems without disrupting existing workflows. This replaces ad hoc choices with evidence-based decisions.

papers.title_en: Why Bother Me Again? Benchmarking Personal Agent Memory for Interaction Preferences
papers.authors: Jialin Li, Zhenhao Chen, Hanjun Luo, Hanan Salam
papers.evidence: 面向个人智能体交互偏好记忆的基准
papers.tldr: 个人智能体常因重复提问、多余确认和主动打扰造成交互负担，关键在于记住用户的交互偏好。作者提出 MemPABench 交互式基准，用四个模拟用户、14 项偏好和 99 个会话进行长程在线评估，考察澄清、确认与自主行动时机。评测四种记忆系统与四个 LLM 骨干后发现，现有记忆对偏好选择增益有限，检索式系统不优于无记忆，文件式记忆虽提升准确率却会跨情境误用偏好。该工作揭示交互偏好记忆与更新仍是瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Personal intelligence systems are taking on increasingly complex everyday tasks, yet repeated questions, unnecessary confirmations, and unwanted outreach can turn capable assistance into interaction burden. Reducing this burden requires agents to remember how users want to be assisted. However, existing memory benchmarks focus on factual recall and personalized answers and rarely test how agents learn and act on interaction preferences. We introduce MemPABench, an interactive environment for on-policy evaluation of memory in personal agents. MemPABench poses long-horizon tasks requiring agents to decide when to clarify, confirm, or act autonomously. Four grounded simulated users hold 14 preferences across work and personal contexts. Their feedback spans 99 sessions over four months, with five event-driven changes per user testing memory updates. We evaluate preference selection, delivered behavior, and sensitivity to context and preference change. Evaluating four memory systems across four LLM backbones, we find that current memory brings limited gains in preference selection. Retrieval-based systems (i.e. Mem0, MemOS, simple RAG) do not outperform No Memory, while File-based memory improves accuracy but applies preferences beyond relevant contexts. Our analysis shows that current memory struggles to retrieve interaction preferences and adapt to preference changes. Even with the correct preference available, overriding the agent's default interaction habits remains challenging. The environment and dataset are available at https://mempabench.com.

papers.title_en: Have I Scene This Before? Spatially Grounded Conversational Memory for Complex Queries in Egocentric Assistants
papers.authors: Jiazhou Liang, Liam Gallagher, Kiko Chen, David Guo, Armin Toroghi, Yifan Simon Liu, Scott Sanner
papers.evidence: 面向第一视角助手的目标中心对话工作记忆
papers.tldr: 第一人称助手需在长交互历史中连接用户话语与所见场景，现有视觉语言模型推理成本高且检索易漏证据。作者提出SpaC-MEM，以对象为中心、用3D重建与分割把对话信息锚定到持久物理对象，压缩多模态历史并支持对话更新。在Ego-SpaCR基准上，其总体答案准确率最高、对象召回提升且参考输入token显著减少；移除3D空间信息会明显掉点，说明空间与对话证据需联合保留。
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric assistants must connect what users say with what they see across long interaction histories. We formalize this challenge as Spatially grounded Conversational Reasoning (SpaCR): cross-scene, recall-oriented, and counterfactual spatial queries that combine user-stated facts with geometric evidence. Direct vision-language models incur high inference costs and context limits as histories grow, while keyframe selection and retrieval can omit objects or evidence needed for complete recall. We propose Spatially grounded Conversational Memory (SpaC-MEM), an object-centric working memory that uses 3D reconstruction and segmentation to ground conversational information in persistent physical objects. It compresses multimodal histories while preserving spatial evidence and allowing object-specific facts to be updated through dialogue. We also introduce Ego-SpaCR, a benchmark comprising 620 ScanNet video sessions augmented with 95 task-oriented conversations and 3,100 evaluation queries. SpaC-MEM achieves the highest overall answer accuracy among the evaluated methods and improves object recall while requiring substantially fewer reference input tokens than native-video baselines. Removing 3D spatial information substantially degrades performance, highlighting the importance of preserving spatial and conversational evidence together.

papers.title_en: MemCo: Memory-Centric Collaboration for Generalizing LLM Agents to Unseen Environments
papers.authors: Xinting Liao, Siyan Liu, Rabab K. Ward, Holger R. Roth, Xiaoxiao Li
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的记忆中心协作与情景记忆检索
papers.tldr: LLM智能体在未知交互环境中需通过观察、行动与反馈做序贯决策，但现有记忆设计孤立、轨迹采集昂贵，共享记忆又受粒度困扰。MemCo提出以记忆为中心的协作框架，维护互补的局部与全局记忆：局部保留环境细节，全局沉淀可迁移工作流。在线交互时按当前状态与决策阶段路由两类记忆，避免盲目迁移环境特定细节。实验表明其提升任务成功率并减少冗余探索，为跨环境泛化提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in interactive environments, where they need to make sequential decisions through observation, action, and feedback. Although memory can help agents reuse experience, existing work designs memory in isolation, where collecting enough trajectories to populate it is expensive. Existing shared-memory approaches mitigate isolated experience by pooling episodic memories across tasks and environments. However, retrieving shared memory is challenged by the granularity, where retrieved memories can be either too specific to preserve current grounding or too coarse to support the next action. In this work, we propose MemCo, a memory-centric collaboration framework for generalizing LLM agents to unseen interactive environments. It maintains complementary local and global memory spaces, preserving environment-specific details locally while promoting transferable workflows induced from local trajectories to global memory. During online interaction, MemCo routes relevant local and global memories in terms of the agent's current state and decision phase, enabling agents to reuse the experience of other agents without blindly transferring environment-specific details. Experiments on interactive decision-making benchmarks show that MemCo improves task success and reduces redundant exploration compared with isolate-memory and shared-memory baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/SYannL/nvdamas.

papers.title_en: RIT-RAG: Navigating Document Corpora with Retrieval-Induced Trees
papers.authors: Meghanadh Pulivarthi, Swaraj Kumar Biswal, Kushagra Bhushan, Yatin Nandwani, Sachindra Joshi, Dinesh Raghu
papers.evidence: 将内容检索与文档树结构导航结合的结构感知检索增强策略
papers.tldr: 现有RAG常以孤立文本块检索，缺乏文档结构，难以区分真正相关证据与表面相似内容；结构化方法又受限于大语料无法放入上下文，且易锁定错误文档。RIT-RAG离线按目录或站点地图为每篇文档建树，查询时先广泛检索文本块，再据其位置诱导可管理的子树，供LLM代理跨文档导航、选择性阅读并改写查询。该方法在金融、科学与客服基准上取得最高答案准确率，并在含284万技术文档网页的EntQABench上较最强基线提升6.8至11.4个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds language models in external corpora. Agentic RAG enables iterative search, yet exposes the model to isolated chunks without document structure, making it difficult to distinguish relevant evidence from chunks that merely resemble the query. Structure-aware methods such as PageIndex navigate document structure but cannot scale to the structures of large corpora, which do not fit in the LLM context. Hence, they first commit to a single document using a document retriever and cannot recover from a wrong choice. We propose RIT-RAG (Retrieval-Induced Tree RAG), which combines content retrieval with structural navigation. Offline, RIT-RAG builds a tree for each document from its table of contents or sitemap. At query time, it retrieves a broad set of chunks and uses their positions to induce manageable sub-trees, potentially across multiple documents. An LLM agent navigates these sub-trees, selectively reads promising nodes, and reformulates queries when needed. Thus, retrieval proposes where to look, while the agent decides what to read. Across financial, scientific, and customer-support benchmarks, RIT-RAG achieves the highest answer accuracy among vanilla, graph-based, and agentic baselines. On EntQABench, our new benchmark of 2.84 million technical-documentation webpages, it improves accuracy by 6.8 to 11.4 points over the strongest baseline across three LLMs.

papers.title_en: Beyond the Final Embedding: Retrieving Memories from Token-Level Evidence
papers.authors: Han Luo, Zhan Zhuang, Xu He, Jujia Zhao, Yu Li, Suqin Yuan, Dong Li, Lei Feng
papers.evidence: 面向记忆增强助手、从存储对话中检索记忆的词元级稀疏匹配
papers.tldr: 记忆增强助手依赖嵌入检索，但单向量比较常忽略仅由局部片段决定的相关性。该方法利用同一嵌入模型已算出的上下文 token 表示做稀疏 token 匹配，将查询 token 的匹配分数聚合后与整体记忆相似度融合排序，无需额外训练；还可训练低秩查询适配器。八个基准和多种模型族上检索均有提升，查询适配在 Qwen3-Embedding-4B 上使平均 Recall@10 与 NDCG@10 分别提升 13.3 和 14.3 个百分点。检索增益进一步转化为长期记忆问答准确率提升。
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented assistants retrieve evidence from stored conversations and documents to answer queries. Most embedding-based retrievers compare single-vector representations of queries and memories, even when relevance depends on a small part of the content. Such local evidence can be matched to queries using the contextual token representations already computed by the same embedding models. Our method uses sparse token matching to improve retrieval without additional training. Each query token retrieves a small set of matching tokens across candidate memories. The matching scores are aggregated for each memory and combined with whole-memory similarity to rank memories. An optional low-rank query adapter can be trained with supervision while keeping the encoder and stored memory representations fixed. Our method improves retrieval across eight benchmarks and multiple model families without additional training. Query adaptation further increases the gains to 13.3 and 14.3 percentage points in average Recall@10 and NDCG@10 on Qwen3-Embedding-4B. These retrieval gains translate into higher question-answering accuracy on long-term memory benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Spatial Memory by Agents, for Agents
papers.authors: Qianwei Wang, Ce Zhang, Zhanpeng Luo, Pengpeng Su, Shuo Yang, Hao Xu
papers.evidence: 智能体自动设计记忆构建与检索
papers.tldr: 空间记忆让机器人复用过去观测以支持定位、导航与问答，但“保留什么、如何检索”需面向语义、度量与时间需求联合设计。论文让编码智能体在固定预算下迭代编写并评估记忆构建与检索代码，再用冻结实现处理未见观测历史。三个独立搜索中，Codex/GPT-6 Astra 五任务均分44.23，较最强基线ReMEmbR的29.32提升50.9%。这表明编码智能体可自动化空间记忆设计，并揭示性能与计算成本的任务相关权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Spatial memory enables robots to reuse past observations for localization, navigation, and question answering. Designing such memory involves jointly deciding what to retain and how to retrieve it for diverse semantic, metric, and temporal needs. We investigate whether coding agents can automate this design process through iterative implementation and evaluation. Under a fixed development budget, a Designer Agent writes and revises code for memory construction and retrieval using feedback from a fixed Query Agent. The resulting implementations are frozen before building memories from held-out observation histories, without access to downstream questions, and evaluated across five complementary task tracks using the same Query Agent. Across three independent design searches, Codex / GPT-6 Astra averages 44.23 on the equally weighted five-track score, versus 29.32 for ReMEmbR, the strongest evaluated baseline supporting all five tracks, a 50.9% relative improvement. Qualitative analysis relates performance differences to evidence retention and retrieval, while identifying grounding and evidence-use failures. These results demonstrate the potential of coding agents to automate spatial memory design, while revealing task-dependent trade-offs in performance and computational cost. Project page: https://ba-fa-3344.github.io/.

papers.title_en: Beyond Success Rate: Interventional Evaluation of Memory in Vision-Language-Action Systems
papers.authors: Keyuan Luo, Yi Xie, Wanyun Ling, Yuanzhe Li, Ziyue Li, Zhuoqi Zeng
papers.evidence: 用干预实验检验智能体记忆检索是否真正起作用
papers.tldr: 仅看成功率难以判断VLA系统是否真正使用记忆，因为信息与计算被同时改变且聚合指标会掩盖得失。论文提出介入式记忆评估协议IMEP，在检索接口做目标事实替换、保事实替换、最小数值扰动与精确副本，并分离决策正确性和运动执行成功。跨回合实验显示ULP干预改变11.9%配对结果，而改关键事实相较保事实替换无额外清晰效应；ChainBench中完整记忆将成功率从39.1%提升至74.3%。这表明正确历史可支撑决策，但记忆收益需事实特定证据而非只看聚合成功率。
papers.abstract_en: When we say that a robot uses memory, does that memory actually play a role? Success-rate ablations alone cannot establish the use of task-relevant facts: they change information and computation together, while aggregate rates can hide offsetting gains and losses. We propose an Interventional Memory Evaluation Protocol (IMEP) for vision-language-action (VLA) systems to address four questions: (1) Does memory provide a net benefit? (2) Under what conditions does memory help? (3) Do changes to memory alter task outcomes? (4) Are these effects specific to task-relevant facts? At the retrieval interface, we compare target-fact substitutions with fact-preserving replacements, minimal numerical perturbations, and exact replicas, while assessing decision correctness separately from motor execution success. We evaluate within-episode, cross-episode, and agentic memory. In cross-episode learned-bank experiments, a one-unit-in-the-last-place (ULP) intervention, including its installation procedure, changes 11.9% of seed-paired outcomes, while changing key facts produces no clear additional effect over fact-preserving replacements. To examine when memory helps, we introduce ChainBench, where correct decisions require historical information unavailable in current observations. The full memory configuration raises task success from 39.1% to 74.3%, matching the oracle-decision condition under shared recorded executions. These results show that correct history can support robot decisions, but establishing whether a memory system realizes this benefit requires fact-specific evidence beyond aggregate success rates.

papers.title_en: Mixture-of-Memories: Low-Overhead Language Modeling with Modular Knowledge Injection
papers.authors: Yifan Lu, Rubin Wei, Ziyun Zou, Junhong Liang, Haolin Yang, Xinlin Zhuang, Abhijit Das, Adinath Madhavrao Dukre, Shadab Khan, Zhouhan Lin, Imran Razzak
papers.evidence: 通过模块化外部知识注入的记忆增强语言建模
papers.tldr: 大模型事实知识难以控制、更新与可靠调用，现有记忆增强方法多以单一机制对所有词元施加同样修正。MoM将路由神经记忆与可写事实记忆分离：冻结基座模型配潜在记忆和词法记忆，预算路由器按不确定性与分歧为每词元设混合权重；外部显式记忆绕过路由器，支持免训练追加事实并由答案级门控使用。实验显示其在语言建模、事实问答、更新分析和效率上同时提升准确性与可更新性，且推理开销低。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models store substantial factual knowledge in their parameters, yet this knowledge is difficult to control, update, and reliably elicit at inference time. Existing memory-augmented approaches typically rely on a single auxiliary mechanism, such as retrieval, parameter updates, or neural memory, and therefore apply the same form of correction to tokens with very different knowledge demands. We propose Mixture-of-Memories (MoM), a memory-augmented language modeling framework that separates routed neural memory from writable factual memory. MoM combines a frozen base LM with two neural memory experts: a latent memory that provides low-latency hidden-state corrections and a lexical memory that provides a token-space knowledge pathway. A lightweight Budget Router sets per-token mixture weights from uncertainty and disagreement features, replacing the fixed interpolation of prior memory modules. For post-hoc updates, an external explicit memory stays outside the router, because a router trained before facts are written learns to down-weight it; new facts are appended without retraining any component and used only when an answer-level gate accepts the retrieved fact. Experiments across language modeling, factual QA, update analysis, and efficiency show that MoM improves both predictive accuracy and updateability while retaining low inference overhead.

papers.title_en: Temporal Evidence-Parameter Co-Alignment for LLM Reasoning over Temporal Knowledge Graphs
papers.authors: Jiapu Wang
papers.evidence: 面向时序推理的检索与参数协同对齐策略
papers.tldr: LLM静态参数记忆难以对齐动态知识，现有RAG偏重语义相关而忽视时间有效性与事件顺序，PEFT固定低秩更新也难刻画实体演化。TEPCA在证据层用时间约束动态相关性路径剪枝与互信息剪枝保留连贯时序证据，在参数层提出时间戳条件动态门控LoRA调制适配子空间。两个TKG基准上达SOTA，DG-LoRA在八个常识QA数据集验证自适应、可扩展与可解释性。该工作实现证据与参数双层次时间对齐，提升时序知识图谱推理能力。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle with temporally grounded reasoning because their static parametric memory is misaligned with the dynamic evolution of real-world knowledge. Although RAG and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) provide practical ways to enhance LLMs, they remain insufficient for temporal reasoning. Existing retrieval methods typically prioritize semantic relevance while overlooking temporal validity, event order, and evolutionary dependencies, resulting in evidence that is relevant in isolation but temporally fragmented. Meanwhile, conventional PEFT methods usually employ fixed and input-agnostic low-rank updates, making it difficult to capture time-dependent entity semantics and relation drift. To address these limitations, we propose Temporal Evidence-Parameter Co-Alignment (TEPCA), a framework for LLM reasoning over TKGs. TEPCA aligns LLM reasoning with temporal knowledge at both the evidence and parameter levels. At the evidence level, it introduces time-constrained Dynamic Relevance-Guided Path (DRGP) pruning to preserve globally coherent temporal paths, together with Mutual-Information (MI)-based pruning to retain query-informative local facts under temporal constraints. At the parameter level, it integrates Dynamic-Gated LoRA (DG-LoRA), a timestamp-conditioned low-rank adaptation mechanism that dynamically modulates the effective adaptation subspace according to temporal context. This design enables LLMs to better capture fine-grained entity evolution and time-dependent relation semantics while preserving parameter efficiency. Experimental results on two TKG benchmarks demonstrate that TEPCA achieves state-of-the-art performance. Additional evaluations of DG-LoRA on eight commonsense QA datasets further verify its general input-adaptive capacity, scalability across LLM backbones, and interpretability.

papers.title_en: Cache2LoRA: Understanding and Improving Context Internalization
papers.authors: Yi Fang, Gaurav Srivastava, Zhenyu Bi, Sirui Ding, Xuan Wang
papers.evidence: 基于冻结文档缓存的查询驱动证据聚合以支撑回答
papers.tldr: 上下文转LoRA能把文档压缩为低秩参数更新，但现有方法在竞争来源、事实保留和指令适配间难以兼顾。Cache2LoRA用查询从可复用冻结文档缓存聚合证据，再生成LoRA更新，并仅训练查询与记忆令牌后缀。17项任务上宏F1达0.663，接近全上下文ICL的0.671，32K文档解码吞吐为后者5.9倍。该工作拆解了上下文内化瓶颈，并提升了长文档场景的效率与混合记忆效果。
papers.abstract_en: Context-to-LoRA methods encode documents as low-rank parameter updates, allowing language models to answer without retaining the source text in their decoding context. How reliably do these updates preserve facts and support their use under different instructions? Controlled diagnosis of existing context-to-LoRA methods separates fact discrimination, target retention, and response adaptation. Competing sources influence answers, while target-only construction and memory-state optimization improve recovery at fixed update size. Recovering facts also does not ensure that answers follow response instructions. We introduce Cache2LoRA, which uses each query to aggregate evidence from a reusable frozen document cache before generating LoRA updates. Trainable encoding operates only on the query and memory-token suffix, and multi-style supervision teaches both evidence preservation and answer expression. Across 17 tasks, Cache2LoRA improves on existing context-to-LoRA methods and achieves macro F1 of 0.663, approaching full-context in-context learning at 0.671. For 32K documents and 256-token outputs at batch size 16, its decoding throughput is 5.9$\times$ that of full-context ICL. At matched memory size, generated LoRA preserves answer accuracy more reliably than the learned-KV variant under long, diverse intervening text and combines more effectively with retained document KV, yielding higher hybrid F1 and EM.

papers.title_en: Pre-Query Retention with Bounded Bit and Word Retrieval
papers.authors: Pranav Singh, Prashant Singh
papers.evidence: 智能体查询前记忆保留与有界档案检索的理论研究
papers.tldr: 智能体需在未知未来问题前保留信息，并从不可变二进制档案中检索证据，同时受限于每次响应可读取的原始比特或字宽。论文刻画一比特读存储单元，构造覆盖全部记录空间的编码器，并用决策树计数与熵逆分析多次读取下界。结果显示字读取界与比特界最多相差两个保留比特，特定条件下raw-word缓存达到精确最优，对话实验也验证类别充分统计量更省存储且解码更快。该工作揭示响应宽度与未来查询结构如何共同决定保留需求。
papers.abstract_en: An agent can retain information before receiving a future question and later retrieve evidence from an archive. Evaluating this arrangement requires accounting for both retained information and the width of each retrieval response. Decision-tree capacity bounds describe individual sets of distinguishable records, but a memory writer must encode every possible record before the query is known. We study fixed-length retention beside an immutable binary archive, with a worst-case limit on raw bit or word reads. We characterize feasible one-bit-read memory cells and construct encoders that partition the complete record space. Supporting pairwise exclusive disjunction and conjunction with one bit read is equivalent to supporting every Boolean query. For multiple reads, we combine explicit encoders with decision-tree counting and an entropy converse. The word-read bounds differ by at most two retained bits when the read budget is at most half the archive length. Under an explicit condition on word width and archive length, raw-word caching attains the exact optimum among all writers. A related condition preserves this optimum under positive average error. Exhaustive checks validate the implementations. In a matched dialogue-agent study, a categorical sufficient statistic preserves source decisions with less storage and lower decoding latency than the universal encoder. A catalogue-specific index reduces private state further and requires additional shared storage. The results characterize how response width and future query structure determine retention requirements.

papers.title_en: Weighted State Souping for Efficient Long-Context Retrieval
papers.authors: William L. Tong, Aryo Lotfi, Emmanuel Abbe, Josh Susskind, Cengiz Pehlevan, Eran Malach
papers.evidence: 面向长上下文检索的缓存记忆状态查询相关重组
papers.tldr: 状态空间模型推理快、状态固定，但用 state souping 缓存并重组分块状态时，在长且拥挤的上下文中性能下降。本文提出加权 state souping，学习依赖查询的权重来组合缓存状态，并可转为稀疏变体。方法在单跳/多跳文档问答、大海捞针、变量跟踪和工具使用上显著提升长上下文表现，稀疏版近常数编码成本。它为大规模文档、工具和结构化上下文提供可复用表示与选择性检索结合的高效建模思路。
papers.abstract_en: State space models (SSMs) combine fast inference and fixed state size with competitive language-modeling performance. Recently, state souping has been proposed as a procedure whereby an SSM independently encodes chunks of tokens like documents, tool definitions, or memory records. The resulting state encodings may be cached and recombined to cheaply construct a context for downstream queries. However, both state souping and vanilla SSMs deteriorate on long, crowded contexts, limiting their utility for long-horizon domains. To address this issue, we propose weighted state souping, a simple method that learns query-dependent weights for composing cached states. The resulting models improve long-context performance substantially across both single- and multi-hop document question answering, needle-in-a-haystack retrieval, variable tracking, and tool use. Our method can be further adapted into an efficient sparse variant, yielding near-constant encoding cost with respect to context length while preserving (and sometimes improving) performance. We also present simple theoretical arguments that illustrate why souping works and when it may fail, and discuss informally the advantages of weighted souping. Weighted state souping thus combines reusable context representations with selective retrieval, offering an efficient approach to language modeling over large collections of documents, tools, and other forms of structured context that increasingly dominate modern agentic workloads.

papers.title_en: GRaSP: Latency-Aware Optimization for Geo-Distributed Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Hardik Ruparel, Raj Kumar Pandey, Pramod Kumar
papers.evidence: 面向地理分布式RAG的延迟感知检索选择层
papers.tldr: 跨地域 RAG 受广域时延、跨区成本与数据驻留约束，传统仅按语义相似度排序会抬高尾延迟和成本。论文形式化 Geo-RAG 选择问题 GRaSP，作为无需重训的再评分层，按延迟衰减相关性并可选加成本惩罚，受基数预算与区域配额约束。作者证明基础形式是分区拟阵线性目标，可用 O(N log N) 贪心最优求解，仅在附加出网预算时变难。四区域 WAN 与 NQ 实验中，中等延迟下 P90 取回延迟降 41%，保留 relevance-only 78% 召回，端到端延迟降 43%，EM 差距不超 0.062，显示其可作低开销选择层。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is increasingly served across geo-distributed cloud and edge infrastructures, where wide-area latency, cross-region egress cost, and data-residency rules compete with retrieval quality. Conventional pipelines rank by semantic similarity alone and ignore where content lives, inflating tail latency and cost. We formalize the Geo-RAG Selection Problem (GRaSP), a drop-in re-scoring layer that decays relevance by latency and adds an optional cost penalty under a cardinality budget and per-region caps, with no retraining. We first settle its complexity: the base formulation is a linear objective over a partition matroid, solved optimally by an O(N log N) greedy algorithm, rather than NP-hard as a knapsack framing suggests, with hardness entering only under an additive egress budget. On a five-node CloudLab testbed emulating a four-region WAN over the Natural Questions corpus (2.68M passages), GRaSP's benefit is placement-dependent: under uniform placement it cuts fetch latency at negligible quality cost; under topical (residency-like) placement it traces a recall-latency Pareto frontier that dominates relevance-only, nearest-k, and a latency-budgeted baseline. At a moderate latency setting, GRaSP lowers P90 fetch latency by 41% while retaining 78% of relevance-only's recall, with sub-millisecond selection overhead, stable to 200 queries/s. Findings generalize across four public BEIR benchmarks. In end-to-end question answering, GRaSP reduces context-fetch latency by 43% while remaining within 0.062 absolute EM of relevance-only retrieval.
